breaking.member: author ContentIndex kinds and reference constraints
breaking.change: ContentIndex and evaluated graphs distinguish the source factory from its primary output kind. Domain schemas map model-program to model, effect-texture to texture, sfx to sound, vfx2d to flipbook, theme to pack and font-extension to font-pack. Output reference constraints no longer include source-factory aliases. Model program and theme inheritance references require original source declarations, not other same-kind or derived outputs.
breaking.fix: Use the entry's factory to identify its source decoder and kind to identify what consumers receive. Keep the existing factory calls and reference IDs. For parameterized models, point program at a model-program entry; for theme inheritance, point extends at a theme entry. This foundation does not yet switch CLI/scaffold formats or domain cook frontends.
